title: Europe’s democratic renewal is coming from the margins — and Brussels still isn’t listening
lede: None of Serbia, Albania or Bosnia and Herzegovina are full EU members. Brussels generally approaches them as recipients of European democratic standards, not as teachers. But what if Europe's democratic renewal comes not from its political centres, but from its edges?
